services.name: Pitched roof solar installation

services.name: Roof assessment
services.blurb: Membrane, foam, canales, parapet height and the electrical panel checked before any layout.

services.name: Battery backup
services.blurb: Batteries sized for the swamp cooler, well pump and fridge you need during an outage.

services.name: Inverter service
services.blurb: Error codes read, connections checked and failed inverters replaced with the old part shown.

services.name: Wind and hail check
services.blurb: Racking bolts, ballast and panel glass checked after spring wind or a summer hail storm.

services.name: Critter guard
services.blurb: Mesh along the array edge so birds and pack rats stay out from under the panels.

services.name: Detach and reset
services.blurb: Panels taken down and put back when your flat roof is recoated or replaced.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our parapet is almost three feet tall. Lucia measured it, showed us how far the December shadow reaches and set the first row back from it. Winter production looks the way she said.
reviews.name: Daniel C.

reviews.text: They checked the foam roof before anything else and told us it needed a recoat first. Honest, and it meant the panels did not have to come off two years later.
reviews.name: Rosa V.

reviews.text: We are on a well in Placitas. They sized a battery for the well pump, the fridge and the swamp cooler, and explained what would not run. Power stayed on in the last outage.
reviews.name: Gary F.

reviews.text: After a windy April a few ballast blocks had shifted. They came out, reset the blocks, tightened every bolt and sent photos of each corner of the array.
reviews.name: Michelle A.

reviews.text: Pack rats were chewing wires under the panels. They cleaned it out, repaired two cables and put mesh all around. A year later, no more chewing.
reviews.name: Ernesto B.

reviews.text: Our roofer needed the panels off for a new membrane. Parapet took them down, stored them and put them back with new seals the week the roof was done.
reviews.name: Karen J.

proof.guarantee: If a roof penetration we made leaks within 10 years, we repair the roof and the seal.
